project.name: llmgw-mcp
project.description: MCP Gateway semantics (Chapter-9 §9.3, ADR-0010): four-step admission (authentication done by the shared ingress, protocol validation with mirror headers, default-deny tool authorization, upstream reconstruction), MCP 2026-07-28 Modern downstream, one-way Modern-to-Legacy bridging with single-exchange isolation, credentials from configured secrets only, and approval integration for high-risk tools.
